1. Scope

This policy explains how MarkdownIt!, published by CHENXI LI, an individual developer (“we”), handles information. Versions modified or distributed independently by other parties are subject to their respective publishers’ policies.

MarkdownIt! is a local Markdown reader and editor. It does not require an account, include advertising, analytics SDKs or cross-app tracking, or provide developer-operated document storage, synchronization or AI/search relay servers.
2. Information processed on your device

rows.text: Documents you select and resources such as images within authorized locations
Used for reading, rendering and editing. Documents are saved in place and accessed within system-granted permissions. They are not automatically uploaded to the developer.

The names, locations and system access bookmarks for up to 10 distinct documents and their authorized resource folders are stored on your device for reopening. These records contain no copy of the document text. Bookmarks cannot override system permissions.

Associated text ranges, underline states and annotation text are stored in the app’s local data directory, keyed by the full document path and protected by the system. They do not modify the Markdown file, remain after closing it and may be included in system device backups.
The model service address, model name, interface preference, search provider selection and their respective API keys are stored together in the device’s Keychain to establish your chosen connections.

Digest identifiers of allowed model service addresses and identifiers of allowed search services are stored on your device. Permission is remembered separately for each service; changing its model or API key does not change that permission.

Stored in the device’s Keychain using protection that allows access while the device is unlocked and restricts the item to that device. The native network layer uses the key for authentication. It is not provided to document-rendering web content or sent as AI conversation text.

text.text: To resume after the system terminates the app, the app saves recovery data for the current document on your device: working text, undo/redo history, reading position and selection, underlines and annotation drafts, AI conversations, search queries and results, retrieved webpage excerpts, referenced image snapshots and unsent drafts. Recovery data uses system file protection, is excluded from device backups and is not sent to the developer. Model connection information remains solely in the Keychain and is not included in recovery data.

Successfully closing or switching documents clears the corresponding reading recovery data. AI conversations, references, image snapshots, model context and unsent drafts are saved separately on your device by the full document path, with the same file protection and backup exclusion. They remain when switching modes, collapsing the panel, moving to the background, and closing and reopening the document. An interrupted answer keeps the content already received and waits for you to choose whether to retry. If the original file cannot be accessed, recovery data remains on the device without overwriting other files.

The app uses local system logs for technical information such as service hosts, models, request identifiers, timings, status and error codes, and usage, to diagnose requests and session restoration. Logs contain no API keys, document text, questions or answers. The system manages their retention; they are not sent to the developer.
3. Optional AI, web search and model-list requests
You configure the AI service address, model and API key. Requests go directly to the service you configure, without passing through a developer-operated server.

Before documents, conversations or images are first sent to a service, the app explains the scope and destination and asks for your explicit permission. Canceling sends nothing and keeps your question and reference in the composer. Once allowed, the app does not ask again for that service. A different service address requires new permission. Earlier text-only permission does not automatically authorize image sharing.

items.text: Entering or changing valid connection details in model settings may automatically request a model list, including before you tap Done. This request uses your API key for authentication and does not contain document text.

Sending an AI message transmits the entire current document, selected passage, your question and the current conversation history to your configured service. Requests may also include the document filename, content version and currently available capabilities. Selecting a passage does not limit transmission to that passage.
Long conversations may be summarized by the same service, and long documents or references may be sent in parts on demand. Summarization also sends relevant conversation content to that service.
Source-editing tasks may involve follow-up model requests containing current-document tool arguments, results and changes.

Selected images are sent as actual image content with your question. Global AI initially receives an inventory of referenced images and may read relevant pictures on demand; the app does not proactively send every image each round. Local images remain subject to existing file permissions; remote images are downloaded from their referenced URLs. Original EXIF and GPS metadata are removed. Sent image snapshots remain with that document’s AI conversation for follow-up questions and retries.
The app does not separately add the file’s absolute system path. Paths, links and other information already present in the document remain part of the transmitted text.
Reading underlines and annotations are not automatically added to AI requests. Annotation text you choose to copy into a question is handled as part of that question.

text.text: When requested, the model can obtain the current system time and time zone through a local read-only tool. The result is shared with your configured AI service. Clearing AI history removes the current document’s conversation and model context while preserving the unsent draft, current reference, and document undo/redo history.

Web search is off by default. You choose a search provider and supply your own API key. Once enabled, AI may use it as needed. Before the first request to a search service, the app identifies the provider and the types of data to be sent, and asks for permission to share search results and extracted page content. Canceling sends no search request and allows the answer to continue using existing information. Permission is remembered for that service and sending scope.

Search requests go directly to the chosen provider and include search terms, search parameters such as language, and its authentication key. Queries may be derived from your question or document. When reading a webpage, its URL is sent directly to your selected service that supports extraction, which retrieves the target page. Search results and retrieved excerpts are supplied to your approved model service and retained locally with the conversation for follow-up questions, recovery and retries. The search provider may process queries, authentication information, IP addresses and request logs under its own policies.

We do not collect your documents or conversations into developer-operated services for advertising, profiling or model training. Your chosen provider may process request content, authentication information, IP addresses and connection logs. Its retention periods, training uses, processing locations and deletion practices depend on that provider and your agreement with it. We cannot promise zero retention on behalf of arbitrary custom services. Review a provider’s privacy policy and terms before using its service.
4. Remote images, links and system services

Remote images in documents, quoted content or AI replies may automatically request their image URLs when displayed. Image hosts may receive your IP address, requested URL, request time and standard network request information. The URL itself may contain parameters. External links are opened through the system in the relevant app or website, whose subsequent handling is governed by its own policy.

Apple or your file and backup providers may process download, diagnostic or backup information under their own policies. Your chosen model, image or email service may process information in another country or region. Local reading does not require AI configuration. Rendering components and fonts work offline when local content contains no remote resources.
5. Information provided when contacting us

When you email the contact address, we receive your email address and the information you choose to provide. We use it only to handle and respond to your message, conduct necessary follow-up and meet applicable legal obligations. Email is processed through email service providers and retained as needed for those purposes. Do not send API keys or unrelated private documents.
6. Retention, deletion and your choices

items.text: You manage, move or delete original documents and images at their storage locations. Deleting the app does not automatically delete originals stored elsewhere.

Underlines and annotations can be removed separately at their associated text. Deleting the app removes its local notes; system backups may retain them under their own rules. Notes are associated with file paths and do not move with the original file.

Recent documents are limited to 10 entries, with older entries removed as new entries are added. Deleting the app can remove its local settings, sending permissions and recent records. System backups, file providers and the Keychain may retain information independently under their own rules.

You can use Reset in model settings to remove the complete model and search connection settings, provider keys and legacy key records from the Keychain, clear the API key field and save, or revoke the key with its provider. Do not rely solely on uninstalling the app to clear a key from the Keychain.

You can choose not to use AI or stop an ongoing generation. Stopping cannot retract content already received by a service. Requests concerning access to or deletion of data already received by a third party must be addressed to that provider.

You may contact the address above to request access to, correction of or deletion of information we actually hold. We handle requests according to applicable law and what is within our control. We cannot remotely access or delete documents on your device.

text.text: 7. Protection of information

The app uses system file permissions, the Keychain and web-content isolation to limit access to information. Model settings allow local and other HTTP services. HTTP does not provide transport encryption; HTTPS is recommended for internet services. No security measure guarantees absolute security. Consider the sensitivity of your content when choosing a service address or sharing a document.
8. Minors

The app does not require an age or create profiles of children. Minors using third-party AI services should follow those services’ age requirements and obtain a guardian’s consent where required by applicable law.
9. Updates and contact

We may update this policy as features or applicable requirements change and revise the date above. If changes to information handling require renewed authorization, we will obtain it as required. For questions about this policy or privacy practices, contact
